conviction_note: New numbers plus a plausible outlook reset in the new CEO's first report (CMD on 11 Nov) give a large unsigned move (~8%). The sign is close to a coin flip: five broker target cuts and a 25% 60-day fall have already lowered the bar, which offsets the guidance-cut risk and a Q3 with no flagged large DCT order. So p_up is 47 and the scaled number is -0.48. The findings sum to -1.3 and are not fitted to it.

findings.finding: Five brokers (SEB, Handelsbanken, DNB Carnegie, SB1, Pareto) cut their targets between 28 Sep and 12 Oct and pushed their Q3 DCT margin estimates down to 9.9-11.5%. SB1 calls Q3 the margin bottom. With the stock down about 30% in three months, a weak but in-line Q3 is largely in the price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 adj. EBITA missed (417 vs 437) and the stock rose 9.4% on orders. Earnings misses have not been what moved this name.
findings.original_quote: Komponentbrist och en större kostnadsbas väntas tynga DCT under det tredje kvartalet då DCT-marginalen enligt SB1:s estimat sjunker till 9,9 procent jämfört med 11,3 procent i det andra kvartalet. 'Vi bedömer att det tredje kvartalet blir botten för DCT-marginalen innan volymerna ökar i det fjärde kvartalet' (Component shortages and a larger cost base are expected to weigh on DCT in Q3, with the DCT margin falling to 9.9% by SB1's estimate from 11.3% in Q2. 'We judge Q3 to be the bottom for the DCT margin before volumes rise in Q4.')
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is in Direkt wire copy and the stock has fallen 25% in 60 days. What remains is that a lowered bar makes an in-line weak quarter less damaging than the tape implies. Had this been fully priced and then some, the shorts would be covering, not building (Eleva was building into 1 October).
findings.independence: Handelsbanken separately models a Q3 DCT margin of 11.5% and cuts 2026 adj. EBIT 11%: https://www.placera.se/telegram/munters-handelsbanken-sanker-riktkursen-for-munters-men-tror-pa-aterhamtning-i-dct-marginalerna-20260930

findings.finding: The outlook is at risk of a reset in this release. The guide says the H2 2026 margin improves on the previous year (H2 2025 was about 11.8%, from 13.5% and 10.0%) and sales develop positively. SEB already forecasts organic growth 'far below' that guide, and this is new CEO Aspman's first report, three weeks before his CMD on 11 November.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The outlook was maintained at Q2 (+9.4% day, order-driven). The CEO-acceleration release on 14 Sep coincided with a -4.7% day. There is no prior outlook cut on this name to measure.
findings.original_quote: Det som förväntades bli en tydlig uppgång under det andra halvåret framstår nu som något mer osäkert. Vi intar därför en försiktig hållning, med en prognos för den organiska helårstillväxten som ligger långt under bolagets guidning från det andra kvartalet (What was expected to be a clear upturn in H2 now looks somewhat more uncertain. We therefore take a cautious stance, with a full-year organic growth forecast far below the company's Q2 guidance.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: SEB states the miss against the guide openly, and the stock trades at about 12x EV/EBIT. What is not priced is whether the company itself changes the guide on this day or defers to the CMD. If a cut were fully in the price, the stock would not be holding 127-134 for a month while brokers keep Buy ratings with 190-240 targets.

findings.finding: Munters published no inside-information DCT order in Q3 (1 Jul-30 Sep). The two quarters that drove this stock's largest positive reactions both carried flagged mega-orders: Q4 2025 (82 MUSD and 840 MSEK chillers; +12.45% on that report) and Q2 2026 (BSEK 2.0 on 24 Apr; orders 8,699 against 6,638 consensus, +9.4%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order intake is the line this name trades on: +12.45% (Jan 2026, orders 11,604 vs 9,401 consensus) and +9.39% (Jul 2026, orders 8,699 vs 6,638).
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference from an absence on a public feed, and brokers model orders (Pareto expects +25%), so a normal quarter is in their numbers. What the price may not hold is the loss of the upside order-surprise reaction that rescued the last two prints. Unflagged project awards can still lift orders, which caps this finding.
findings.independence: Pareto's order expectation (+25%, 2.7bn): https://www.placera.se/telegram/munters-pareto-upprepar-kop-for-munters-men-sanker-riktkursen-till-240-kronor-20261012. It cuts the other way on level, so this is not independent confirmation
